description: This file contains functions and types for installing skills, including handling external dependencies, executing commands, and managing installation specifications within a larger software project.

methods.name: withWarnings
methods.description: Adds warnings to a SkillInstallResult if any warnings are provided.

methods.name: resolveInstallId
methods.description: Generates a unique install ID string for a given skill spec and index.

methods.name: findInstallSpec
methods.description: Finds the install specification within a skill entry matching a given install ID.

methods.name: normalizeSkillInstallSpec
methods.description: Normalizes a SkillInstallSpec into a metadata object for easier handling.

methods.name: buildNodeInstallCommand
methods.description: Constructs a package manager command for installing a Node.js package based on preferences.

methods.name: assertSafeInstallerValue
methods.description: Validates installer values against safety patterns to prevent injection or invalid characters.

methods.name: buildInstallCommand
methods.description: Builds the command array to install a skill based on its spec and preferences.

methods.name: resolveBrewBinDir
methods.description: Resolves the directory where Homebrew binaries are installed.

methods.name: createInstallFailure
methods.description: Creates a SkillInstallResult indicating a failure with a message and optional output.

methods.name: createInstallSuccess
methods.description: Creates a SkillInstallResult indicating success with command output.

methods.name: runCommandSafely
methods.description: Executes a command with timeout handling, returning the result or error.

methods.name: runBestEffortCommand
methods.description: Runs a command without throwing on failure, used for best-effort operations.

methods.name: resolveBrewMissingFailure
methods.description: Generates a failure result if Homebrew is not installed.

methods.name: ensureUvInstalled
methods.description: Ensures the 'uv' binary is installed, attempting installation if missing.

methods.name: installGoViaApt
methods.description: Attempts to install Go via apt-get on Linux systems.

methods.name: ensureGoInstalled
methods.description: Ensures the 'go' binary is installed, attempting installation via brew or apt.

methods.name: executeInstallCommand
methods.description: Runs the installation command and returns success or failure result.

methods.name: installSkill
methods.description: Main function to install a skill based on provided parameters, handling dependencies, source validation, and execution.
